Raster grid of a coordinate table

Source: R/util_terra.R
coords_grid.Rd

Internal helpers for the code that works on rasters (the CLUMPY and Dinamica allocators, tabular_to_raster()): a raster covering the coordinate points, and the raster cell of each point, to move values between rows keyed by id_coord and raster cells.

  • coords_grid() builds the grid.

  • coords_cells() finds the cell of every coordinate point in any raster x; points outside it get NA. extract_using_coords_t() reads rasters through it.

  • grid_values() lays values given per coordinate point out over every cell of the grid, in terra's cell order; cells without a coordinate point, or without a value, are NA.

  • grid_to_rast() does the same, but returns a single-layer raster.

  • rast_to_grid() reads a raster on the grid back into one value per coordinate point.

The cells are only meaningful for a regular grid of points: on any other set of points, several points can fall into one cell.

Usage

coords_grid(coords, resolution = NULL)

coords_cells(coords, x)

grid_values(grid, x, value_col)

grid_to_rast(grid, x, value_col)

rast_to_grid(grid, x)

Arguments

coords

A coords_t (or db$coords_minimal): id_coord, lon, lat and an epsg attribute.

resolution

Numeric scalar or NULL; the cell size in CRS units. NULL uses the resolution attribute of coords, or else the smallest distance among its first 1000 points.

x

For grid_values() and grid_to_rast(), a data.table with id_coord and value_col; for coords_cells(), any terra::SpatRaster; for rast_to_grid(), a single-layer terra::SpatRaster on the grid.

grid

A list as returned by coords_grid(): template, an empty terra::SpatRaster, and cells, a data.table with id_coord and cell.

value_col

Character scalar, the column of x holding the values.

Value

coords_grid(): the grid, see grid. coords_cells(): a data.table with id_coord and cell. grid_values(): a vector of the type of x[[value_col]], one element per cell. grid_to_rast(): a terra::SpatRaster with one layer named value_col. rast_to_grid(): a data.table with id_coord and value.
